evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/fixtures/campaign-press-capture-inventory.json and apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/campaign-press.ts: CLM-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CORPUS reconstructs 21 + 7 + 8 + 9 = 45 placements and 44 identities; SRC-NYCAC-NPR-KUAF-CABARET-2017-09-20 is the sole cross-campaign duplicate.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/campaign-press.ts: CLM-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CORPUS cites only the four Press-index sources; metadata observations OBS-PRESS-METADATA-* support no claims, and RT-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CLOSE-READING requires proposition-level review before promotion.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/development-records.ts and apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/nycac-research-2026-07-14.ts: CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY, and CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-NIGHTLIFE-ACCOUNTABILITY name Jamie's organizing, rallying, and testimony while bounding individual causality.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/nycac-research-2026-07-14.ts: SRC-NYCAC-NPR-KUAF-CABARET-2017-09-20, SRC-NYCAC-RA-CABARET-REPEAL-2017-10-31, SRC-NYCAC-COUNCIL-LOCAL-LAW-220-2019, and SRC-NYCAC-MAYOR-CURE-2023-12-28 keep journalist, coalition, Council, and City credit distinct; CLM-WATERWAYS-GREAT-ACCOMMODATIONS-PROGRAM separately preserves Suzanne Hogan's collaborator credit.
findings: Jamie's direct actions remain unusually clear and confident: he started study groups, rallied, testified, co-founded the coalition, built campaign sites, and stewarded operating infrastructure.

Collective campaigns, named partner organizations, Council Member Rafael Espinal, the Council, the Mayor, journalists, and collaborators retain distinct roles; sequence is not converted into personal causality.
Created, caused, passed, and disbanded formulations are either rejected by anti-claims or held behind explicit research tasks.
No material collective-credit or causal-calibration issue requires another iteration.
evals.recommended_next_move: No corrective iteration is required; continue RT-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CLOSE-READING and promote only article-level propositions that preserve actor-specific credit.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx: selected projections for CLM-NYCAC-COFOUNDER-ROLE-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY, CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-NIGHTLIFE-ACCOUNTABILITY, CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW, and CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-REPLACED-BY-CURE distinguish direct action, coalition infrastructure, and government outcomes.

apps/www/src/data/work.ts and apps/www/src/data/proofs.ts: nyc-artist-coalition-public-web-infrastructure, nyc-artist-coalition-civic-systems, and fair-rent-campaign-memory state what Jamie built and what became usable for collaborators without assigning collective policy outcomes to him.

docs/knowledge-bank/promotion-slate.md: CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE and CLM-NYCAC-FIREGUARD-PASS-RATE-ATTESTED remain research items, while CLM-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CORPUS is explicitly retained as knowledge depth rather than projected accomplishment evidence.

apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/campaign-press.ts and docs/knowledge-bank/projects/nyc-artist-coalition-press.md: CLM-NYCAC-CAMPAIGN-PRESS-CORPUS remains dormant with a held, surface-free projection; the 45/44 bibliography is absent from the hiring-site case study.
findings: The material is strong through Chad's lens: direct actions are specific, their civic purpose is clear, and the case study explains what became usable for collaborators and public institutions.

The public selection is purposeful: it projects founding role, concrete organizing, testimony, operating infrastructure, and bounded institutional chronology while excluding the full press bibliography.
Unresolved high-value claims remain visible as prioritized research instead of being weakened into vague copy or prematurely promoted.
No material professional-legibility or editorial-selection issue requires another iteration.
evals.recommended_next_move: Keep the current public-site selection; use future press close reading to add only high-value role, collaborator, or outcome propositions that materially sharpen the hiring argument.
